name: Y2K Inflated Wrapped
tagline: Hot-pink, cyan and orange blocks with a giant yellow extruded 3D number and black pill tags, Spotify-Wrapped-style (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: Hot pink ground with cyan wedge, orange footer band, yellow extruded numerals and black tags

typography.style: Inflated heavy grotesque numerals with condensed Anton headlines and bold Archivo captions

best_for: Single-number-hero recaps and playful year-in-review stories where one big figure carries the slide. Great for consumer, youth and social audiences.
avoid_for: Serious financial, legal or clinical reporting that needs a sober tone.
